text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking around town with <chrname> for a 
short break between training sessions—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overhearing someone call out <chrname>'s name in 
French, you reflexively turn your 
attention toward the voice.

text_block_list.name: Parisian B
text_block_list.text:
"She's a Japanese Umamusume. She's pretty 
strong in Japan, and I hear she's running 
in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe next."

It turns out there were people in Paris 
who knew about <chrname> as well.
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should go talk to them...)

(Let's listen to their conversation a bit 
more.)

(Could this also be the project's 
success...?)

text_block_list.text:
Gathering my courage, I tried speaking to 
them in the French I had learned!

text_block_list.name: Parisian B
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa! So you really were <chrname> after all?! I 
saw your videos on UmaTube, I'm rootin' 
for you~"

text_block_list.name: Parisian A
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, so you both understand French. Did 
you study it?"

Interacting with the fans in Paris seems 
to have been an invaluable experience for <chrname> 
as well!

text_block_list.name: Parisian B
text_block_list.text:
"I saw how hard you were workin' on 
UmaTube to run in the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, and it just made me wanna root 
for you..."

text_block_list.name: Parisian A
text_block_list.text:
"My, my, aren't you going to cheer for our 
genius girl? You two-timer~~"

text_block_list.name: Parisian B
text_block_list.text:
"What's wrong with that?! It doesn't 
matter how many Umamusume I cheer for!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seemed this pleasant conversation was 
clearly understood by <chrname>, who had been 
studying French together with them.

text_block_list.name: Parisian A
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, so she's a pretty famous Umamusume, 
huh? In that case, might as well snap a 
picture~"

text_block_list.name: Parisian A
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me~♪ You're <chrname>-san, right? Could I 
get a picture with you~?"

text_block_list.name: Parisian B
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, really? Then I will too...! —Hehe, 
maybe it's because I've only ever watched 
your streams? It feels kind of surreal..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together with <chrname>, you enjoyed the unexpected 
cross-cultural exchanges brought about by 
the project.
